svg.title: What is inside Lilystack
svg.desc: The sprint: think (office-hours, spec), plan (plan-ceo-review, plan-eng-review, plan-design-review, plan-devex-review, autoplan), check (review, verify, qa, test-audit), ship (ship, feedback). Safety hooks: careful, secrets, secure, test-first, freeze, unfreeze, guard. Anytime: investigate, retro, context-audit, write-skill, prose, frontend-design, security-audit, compound, second-opinion. Lily tools: bin/lily, lily-check, lily-lint, lily-sweep, mods/status. Also inside: the lens agent, the ste output style and the evals.
svg.text: Use the sprint from left to right, or call any skill alone.
Tests an idea, writes a design
Makes a spec you can test
Probes CLI, API and web pages
Finds tests that add no value
Call one, and its hook is active until the session ends. You start these, not Claude.
Looks back at a git window
Writes a skill the diet way
The owner's own builds. They act on Lilypad.
A separate mod. It keeps STATUS.md correct and shows a band above the prompt.
Newer Claude Code parts: a plugin agent, an output style, an eval suite and a marketplace.
A lens that can only read
Every skill is Markdown. Every hook is a bash script. The tables below give each call.
